description: This file defines the ICatalogItemService interface, which describes asynchronous methods for managing catalog items, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving catalog items.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: Interface for catalog item operations including CRUD and listing functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by its ID asynchronously, returning a confirmation message or status.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Returns a paged list of catalog items asynchronously.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves a complete list of catalog items asynchronously.
